purpose: Reproduces the historical h-selection under v1.1 residual construction, so the frozen constants can be reused without silent drift.
residual: z_t = (lam_t - mu0)/sigma0 on the PRE-TRANSFORM smoothed chi-square, gated as production gates it. NOT the rejected z = max(0, 1-c)*10.
selection_rule: smallest h on the fixed grid for which the CLEAN NOMINAL arm produces zero alarms; evaluated only on the clean arm, never on a fault outcome
